tool_args.rationale: The pilot is monotone and concave but narrowly samples the sink gradient. An open-branch probe can distinguish plausible mechanisms and reveal behavior beyond the pilot before fitting a forecasting model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a Haldane, Cobb–Douglas, or saturating sink-gradient model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows vary mainly u_now and keep s_grad near 1, so they cannot identify the gradient dependence or reliably distinguish the candidate mechanisms outside the pilot range.
The immediate ambiguity concerns the response across input regimes, not trajectory resolution; the branch-discriminating probe costs less.
It does not address the mechanism ambiguity.
